requirements.label: Deliverables
requirements.means: Two short, punchy cuts — one 'unboxing-tease', one 'styled-in-the-wild'. Same garment, different POV.

requirements.label: Required Length
requirements.means: Target 28s + 32s. TikTok-native, fast in, fast out.

requirements.label: Theme
requirements.detail: Soft-girl daily-wear; 'one item, three ways' editorial
requirements.means: Highlight the linen-blend drape. Style with a single shoe-swap to flip casual → night.

requirements.label: Tone
requirements.means: Julz Tier-1 + UGC overlay OFF (no dry-funny). Lean editorial-pretty. Soft VO optional.

requirements.label: Required Messaging
requirements.detail: Must say 'Lotus Shop' once + '#lotusgirl' in caption
requirements.means: Spoken brand mention in mid-body. Caption pre-approved by Lotus.

requirements.label: Product Mention/Demo
requirements.means: Mirror twirl + close-up on fabric. Show drape, not just the shape.

requirements.label: Posting Requirements
requirements.means: Stagger posts 48 hrs apart. Peak window: Wed 7pm PT / Sat 11am PT.

requirements.label: Usage Rights
requirements.detail: 60-day organic + paid whitelisting on Lotus handles
requirements.means: Lotus can boost on @lotusshop for 60 days. No extension without retainer.

requirements.label: Payment
requirements.means: Two-tier. Half paid on contract, half on final-approval. NET-15.

requirements.label: Bonus
requirements.means: Optimize for shareability. Caption + thumbnail are the lever.

requirements.label: Deadline
requirements.means: Film May 22–23. Edit window May 24–25. Buffer 5 days.

requirements.label: Revision Policy
requirements.means: Send rough cut for sanity-check before final color/captions to avoid round 2.

requirements.label: Do-Not-Do
requirements.detail: No fast-fashion comparisons, no 'dupe' language, no minors visible
requirements.means: No 'looks like [brand]'. Solo shot. No 'dupe' word in voice or caption.

missingInfo.question: Does whitelisting include Instagram Reels or only TikTok?
Is the second video required to feature a different garment, or same garment / different styling?
Bonus tracked combined-views or per-video views?

meansSummary.goal: Make two editorial-soft 28-32 sec cuts that read as a real wardrobe moment, not a sales placement. Hit the $125 bonus by optimizing share-rate.
meansSummary.audience: Mid-20s to mid-30s women who shop slow-fashion, value drape over branding, hate 'dupe' content.
meansSummary.keyFocus: The fabric-drape moment. Single-shoe-swap day→night reveal. Quiet, intentional pacing.
dos: Open on the mirror twirl, not a brand logo
Show fabric texture in close-up by second 10
Caption pre-approved by Lotus before posting
donts: No frantic cuts — keep pacing slow and intentional
